title: Buddy Petit and buying his horn from his son
summary: Joseph recalls Buddy Petit's many bookings and how he bought Petit's first horn from his son, Little Buddy.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Yeah, I'll tell you. I'll tell you. Yeah, I'll tell you about that. I'll tell you about that. Yeah. I'll tell you about that.
Yeah. Now about Buddy Petit. I was going to ask about Buddy Petit. Do you remember him? How he played? Oh, yeah.

I remember Buddy Petit. Buddy Petit was a terrible man one time. See, Buddy was signed 20 jobs one day. They'd be looking for Buddy. Buddy would be on a lakefront playing for somebody else. People up here would be looking for Buddy. Buddy would be looking for people playing somewhere else. They'd go look Buddy up. They'd go get him out there. Like that. That's the kind of fella. Them kind of fellas.
How was he as a trumpet player?
Oh, he's a good trumpet player. Oh, man. He's the real. You see him? I bought his horn. The first horn he had.

Yeah, I got rid of it. I got another one. I bought another one. I bought his horn from his son. What kind was it? It was a coin. A CD coin I bought from his son. I paid his son. It was $27 for a horn. He had a little head horn. His son was named Little Buddy. See? Well, he is pushed up for money. You understand what I mean? Yeah. Well, his daddy gave him the horn. He's learning. He needed money. He had a wife. And he come to me. He's living right there on his side. He said, man, I want to sell a horn. I said, what you want for it? One time he asked me $35. Man, I couldn't give that. So I said, I had to cash money. I said, give you that for the horn. So, okay, take the horn. Man, I made it for us enough for that horn. His dad was a good trumpet player. Whatever happened to the horn? What happened to the horn? I sold the horn after.
So you don't know where it is?
No, I don't know where it is. I sold.
It's nice for a souvenir, you know, for somebody to have.
See? Well, I really don't know who got the horn. But I sold the horn. I got more than these people. But I paid in for the horn.
Was it an easy horn to blow?
Yeah, it was a fine horn. See, the coin. Did you use the same mouthpiece? No, I used my mouthpiece. I still got my old mouthpiece. A 13C I used.
What kind of a mouthpiece did he use? You know what I think about?
Did you know what kind he had?
No, I didn't know what the mouthpiece he had. I never used it. And what else I took and done? That time, like, Buddy, I used to let you get Buddy and Kid Rene get together.
